goal: Complete paginated reviewer-lease evidence connections (issue/PR comments and reviews over 100) with bounded fail-closed cursor follow-up pages so reviewer draws stop refusing repository-wide
prohibited_actions: do not change verdict, assignment, lease or approval semantics; only complete the evidence read
do not touch any migration or database object
do not edit another session's issue, handoff, worktree, branch, claim or lease
assumptions: GitHub GraphQL connections cap first at 100 and return pageInfo.endCursor
reviewStateEntry remains the fail-closed gate for any still-incomplete connection
stop_conditions: stop if completing the read would require changing verdict recognition
stop if a test fails for a reason unrelated to these files
stop if the change would need to touch a file outside allowed_paths
